items.title_en: CME-CAD: Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning for CAD Code Generation
items.title_zh: CME-CAD：面向CAD代码生成的异构协同多专家强化学习
items.abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is essential in industrial design, but the complexity of traditional CAD modeling and workflows presents significant challenges for automating the generation of high-precision, editable CAD models. Existing methods, such as 3D reconstruction from sketches, often produce non-editable, approximate models that fall short of meeting the stringent requirements for precision and editability in industrial design. Moreover, the reliance on text or image-based inputs often requires significant manual annotation, limiting their scalability and applicability in industrial settings. To overcome these challenges, we propose the Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (CME-CAD) paradigm, a novel training paradigm for CAD code generation. Our approach integrates the complementary strengths of these models, facilitating collaborative learning and improving the model's ability to generate accurate, constraint-compatible, and fully editable CAD models. We introduce a two-stage training process: Multi-Expert Fine-Tuning (MEFT), and Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (MERL). Additionally, we present CADExpert, an open-source benchmark consisting of 17,299 instances, including orthographic projections with precise dimension annotations, expert-generated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) processes, executable CADQuery code, and rendered 3D models. The CADExpert dataset is publicly available at https://modelscope.cn/datasets/zhuofanChen/CADExpert.
items.abstract_zh: CAD在工业设计中至关重要，但传统建模流程复杂，高精度、可编辑CAD模型的自动生成仍十分困难。现有方法（如基于草图的三维重建）多产生不可编辑的近似模型，且依赖文本或图像输入需大量人工标注，难以规模化应用。为此，本文提出异构协同多专家强化学习（CME-CAD）范式，融合多个模型的互补优势，协同提升生成准确、满足约束且完全可编辑CAD模型的能力，训练分为多专家微调（MEFT）与多专家强化学习（MERL）两阶段。同时发布开源基准CADExpert，含17,299个实例，包括带精确尺寸标注的正交投影、专家思维链（CoT）、可执行CADQuery代码与渲染三维模型。
items.highlight_zh: 多专家协同强化学习范式，让CAD代码生成更精确可编辑。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：工业设计需要的是精度高、参数可改的CAD模型，而让AI自动生成这样的模型很难。已有做法多是把草图或图片转成三维网格，结果不可编辑、精度有限，而且训练数据依赖大量人工标注，难以规模化。
2）用了什么方法：提出CME-CAD训练范式，核心思路是“多专家协同”。先把不同来源的模型各自微调（MEFT），再用强化学习让它们协同工作（MERL），把各自擅长的能力合起来，使输出既满足设计约束，又能直接编辑。
3）数据与基准：作者发布开源基准CADExpert，共17,299个实例，每条包含带精确尺寸标注的正交投影图、专家撰写的思维链（CoT）推理过程、可执行的CADQuery代码，以及渲染出的三维模型。
4）有什么结果与为何重要：论文给出的是一套面向CAD代码生成的训练范式与公开数据集，目标是让模型产出可编辑、约束相容的CAD模型，而非不可修改的近似网格。对工业设计而言，这意味着AI生成的设计结果能继续被工程师修改、复用，更贴近真实生产流程；公开数据与代码也便于社区比较与复现。

rm.usage: CAD代码生成与RoboMaster视觉/装配/自瞄任务几乎无关，工程机器人装配不涉及CAD建模，关联很弱。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:PanoEnv: Exploring 3D Spatial Intelligence in Panoramic Envi
items.title_en: PanoEnv: Exploring 3D Spatial Intelligence in Panoramic Environments with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: PanoEnv：在全景环境中通过强化学习探索三维空间智能
items.abstract_en: 360deg panoramic images are increasingly used in VR, autonomous driving, and robotics for holistic scene understanding. However, current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with 3D spatial reasoning on Equirectangular Projection (ERP) images due to geometric distortion and limited 3D supervision. We introduce PanoEnv, a large-scale VQA benchmark built from synthetic 3D environments, containing 14.8K questions across five categories (e.g., relative position, attribute comparison) grounded in accurate 3D annotations--depth, segmentation, and bounding boxes. Benchmarking 14 state-of-the-art VLMs reveals limited 3D understanding, achieving only 49.34% overall and 8.36% on open-ended (OE) questions. To enhance 3D reasoning, we propose a reinforcement learning post-training framework based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a ground-truth-guided reward combining five geometry-aware strategies (e.g., distance tolerance, spatial consistency). A two-stage curriculum further mitigates catastrophic forgetting: Stage 1 trains on structured tasks (T/F, MCQ), and Stage 2 fine-tunes on mixed OE data for generalization. Our 7B model sets a new SoTA performance, improving total accuracy to 52.93% (+3.59%) and OE accuracy to 14.83% while maintaining structured-task performance. It also achieves top semantic scores (Q-Score 6.24, P-Score 5.95), surpassing 32B models. These results demonstrate that PanoEnv-QA and our curriculum-based RL framework effectively instill 3D spatial intelligence in VLMs for omnidirectional perception.
items.abstract_zh: 360度全景图像广泛用于VR、自动驾驶与机器人，但视觉语言模型（VLM）在等距柱状投影（ERP）图像上因几何畸变与三维监督稀缺而难以进行三维空间推理。我们提出PanoEnv：由合成三维环境构建的大规模VQA基准，含五大类共14.8K问题（如相对位置、属性比较），并以深度、分割、边界框等精确三维标注为基础。评测14个先进VLM显示其三维理解有限，总体仅49.34%、开放式问题仅8.36%。为提升三维推理，我们提出基于GRPO的强化学习后训练框架，奖励由真值引导并融合五种几何感知策略（如距离容差、空间一致性），两阶段课程（先结构化任务后混合开放式数据）缓解灾难性遗忘。7B模型取得新SoTA：总准确率52.93%（+3.59%），开放式14.83%，语义得分超越32B模型。
items.highlight_zh: 全景VQA基准加GRPO课程强化学习，为VLM注入三维空间智能。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：全景图（360度）在VR、自动驾驶和机器人中被广泛使用，但视觉语言模型（VLM）看不懂等距柱状投影带来的几何畸变，判断物体远近、位置关系这类三维空间问题能力很弱。
2）用了什么方法：作者先用合成三维环境搭出评测基准PanoEnv，包含14.8K道问答，覆盖相对位置、属性比较等五类，并且有深度、分割、边界框等精确三维标注作参考。随后用基于GRPO的强化学习做后训练，奖励由标准答案引导，并融合距离容差、空间一致性等五种几何感知策略；训练采用两阶段课程——先做判断题、选择题等结构化任务，再在混合的开放式数据上微调，以防模型忘掉已学能力。
3）有什么结果：先测14个主流VLM，整体正确率仅49.34%，开放式问题只有8.36%，说明现有模型基本不具备全景三维理解力。经该方法训练的7B模型把总准确率提到52.93%（+3.59%），开放式问题提到14.83%，同时保持结构化任务成绩，语义评分（Q-Score 6.24、P-Score 5.95）甚至超过32B的大模型。
4）为何重要：它说明强化学习配合课程设计，能有效给VLM补上“全景三维空间感”，并且提供了一个可复用的评测基准，为VR、机器人等需要全方位场景理解的应用提供了改进思路。

rm.usage: 全景环境三维空间推理的VQA基准与RL训练，思路可参考雷达全景/多相机下的空间理解，但本身不解决检测跟踪，需大改造。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:SenseSearch: Empowering Vision-Language Models with High-Res
items.title_en: SenseSearch: Empowering Vision-Language Models with High-Resolution Agentic Search-Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: SenseSearch：通过强化学习赋予视觉语言模型高分辨率智能体搜索推理能力
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are limited by static knowledge and insufficient fine-grained visual analysis, hindering their performance on knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks. While recent research has explored VLMs that employ external tools like search or cropping to enhance model performance, they typically employ tools in isolation and lack the ability to coordinate multiple tools effectively. To address this gap, we propose SenseSearch, the first agentic VLM for search-reasoning that supports adaptive multi-tool coordination via reinforcement learning (RL). Specifically, SenseSearch dynamically integrates the image search, text search, and image crop tools to tackle fine-grained and knowledge-intensive visual understanding challenges. We first construct a high-quality cold-start dataset to instill basic tool-usage behaviors. In the subsequent RL stage, we introduce Batch-Normalized Group Sequence Policy Optimization (BN-GSPO) algorithm to enhance the tool invocation and reasoning ability. To comprehensively evaluate the agentic VLMs on complex visual tasks, we introduce the HR-MMSearch benchmark, the first search-oriented benchmark composed of high-resolution images with knowledge-intensive and search-driven questions. Experiments demonstrate that SenseSearch achieves state-of-the-art performance on open-source search and fine-grained image understanding benchmarks, outperforming baselines by 19.18% on HR-MMSearch. SenseSearch provides a promising path toward agentic VLMs with effective and robust tool invocation capabilities. All code and data are released at https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-MARS.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）受限于静态知识与细粒度视觉分析不足，在知识密集、视觉复杂的任务上表现欠佳。已有工作虽让VLM调用搜索或裁剪等外部工具，但通常孤立使用、缺乏协同。我们提出SenseSearch，首个通过强化学习（RL）支持自适应多工具协同的搜索推理智能体VLM，动态整合图像搜索、文本搜索与图像裁剪以应对细粒度、知识密集的视觉理解。我们构建高质量冷启动数据集赋予模型基本工具使用行为，并在RL阶段提出批量归一化组序列策略优化（BN-GSPO）增强工具调用与推理。同时提出首个面向搜索的高分辨率图像基准HR-MMSearch。实验表明SenseSearch在开源搜索与细粒度图像理解基准上达到最优，在HR-MMSearch上超出基线19.18%。
items.highlight_zh: 首个支持多工具协同的智能体VLM，用强化学习调度搜索与裁剪。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：视觉语言模型的知识是“冻结”的，看图时也抓不住细节，因此在需要查资料或辨认图像细小内容的题目上表现差。让模型调用搜索、裁剪等外部工具是可行思路，但现有做法往往一次只用一种工具，不会协调配合。
2）用了什么方法：提出SenseSearch，这是首个用强化学习来调度多种工具的“搜索推理智能体”模型，能够在图像搜索、文本搜索和图像裁剪之间动态选择组合。训练分两步：先用高质量冷启动数据教会模型基本的工具使用方式，再用新提出的BN-GSPO（批量归一化组序列策略优化）算法强化其工具调用与推理能力。
3）评测与结果：作者构建了HR-MMSearch，这是首个面向搜索的高分辨率图像问答基准，题目需要检索外部知识才能回答。实验显示SenseSearch在开源搜索与细粒度图像理解基准上均取得最好成绩，在HR-MMSearch上比基线高出19.18%。
4）为何重要：它展示了让视觉模型“自己决定何时搜索、何时放大看图”的可行路径，使模型在知识密集与细节密集的真实任务中更可靠；代码与数据均已开源，便于后续研究复用与比较。

rm.usage: 带图像裁剪与搜索的VLM智能体推理，理论上可用于雷达对远距离目标做细粒度裁剪确认，但侧重知识型问答，落地价值有限。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Rob
items.title_en: SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Robust Open-Vocabulary Dense Perception
items.title_zh: SynCLIP：面向鲁棒开放词汇密集感知的同义词连贯语言-图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary dense perception (OVDP) aims to localize objects unseen during training by leveraging textual knowledge. Despite the remarkable progress of recent CLIP-based approaches, we identify a critical limitation: synonym-induced grounding inconsistency, where semantically equivalent expressions yield disparate spatial attention patterns. This inconsistency undermines the robustness and performance of existing methods in real-world OVDP applications. To address this issue, we propose SynCLIP, a Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining framework that enhances synonym-robust grounding for OVDP. SynCLIP introduces a Semantic-consistent Spatial Attention alignment (SSA) module to enhance spatial attention consistency by minimizing discrepancies between attention maps of original and synonymous expressions. Furthermore, a Spatial Attention Refinement (SAR) module selectively strengthens the most semantically relevant spatial regions within aligned maps for more precise and stable grounding. To support synonym-coherent pretraining, we also construct a Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC), which augments each category with multiple synonyms and textual definitions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SynCLIP substantially improves grounding consistency under diverse linguistic variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance among CLIP-based OVDP methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Justlovesmile/SynCLIP.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇密集感知（OVDP）旨在借助文本知识定位训练中未见的目标。尽管基于CLIP的方法进展显著，我们发现一个关键局限：同义词引发的定位不一致，即语义等价的表述会产生差异明显的空间注意力图，削弱现有方法在真实OVDP应用中的鲁棒性与性能。为此，我们提出SynCLIP，一种同义词连贯的语言-图像预训练框架，增强OVDP的同义词鲁棒定位能力。SynCLIP引入语义一致空间注意力对齐（SSA）模块，通过最小化原表述与同义表述注意力图之间的差异提升一致性；并提出空间注意力精炼（SAR）模块，在对齐后的注意力图中选择性强化语义最相关的空间区域，实现更精确稳定的定位。为支持该预训练，我们构建同义词增强视觉语料（SEViC），为每个类别补充多个同义词与文本定义。多基准实验表明，SynCLIP显著提升不同语言变体下的定位一致性，并在基于CLIP的OVDP方法中达到最优。
items.highlight_zh: 对齐同义词的空间注意力，显著提升开放词汇密集感知鲁棒性。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：开放词汇密集感知（OVDP）希望模型靠文字描述找出训练时没见过的物体，比如按“吊灯”这个词在图中框出所有吊灯。作者发现一个被忽视的毛病：同一物体换个同义说法，模型的注意力就会跑到别的地方去，导致定位忽好忽坏，这在真实使用中（用户说法五花八门）很致命。
2）用了什么方法：提出SynCLIP框架。其一是语义一致空间注意力对齐（SSA）模块，强迫原句与同义句产生的注意力图尽量一致，从根上消除同义词带来的分歧；其二是空间注意力精炼（SAR）模块，在对齐后的注意力图上再挑出语义最相关的区域进行强化，让定位更准、更稳。为支撑训练，作者还构建了SEViC语料，为每个类别配上多个同义词与文字定义。
3）有什么结果：在多个基准上，SynCLIP在各类语言变体下都明显提升了定位一致性，并成为基于CLIP的OVDP方法中表现最好的方案。
4）为何重要：它指出了一个隐藏但影响很大的问题——语言侧的同义歧义会破坏视觉定位，并给出简单有效的对齐方案。这意味着模型在面对不同用户的措辞时更可靠，对实际部署的开放词汇分割、检测类应用价值明显，代码已开源。

rm.usage: 同义词连贯的开放词汇密集感知可提升雷达对未见目标（不同机器人/装甲）的开放词汇检测与定位一致性，需迁移改造。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person
items.title_en: Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person Re-identification
items.title_zh: 面向终身行人重识别的提示锚定视觉-文本蒸馏（PAD）
items.abstract_en: Lifelong person re-identification (LReID) aims to train a generalizable model with sequentially collected data. However, such models often suffer from semantic drift, limited adaptability, and catastrophic forgetting as new domains emerge. Existing exemplar-free approaches largely rely on visual-only distillation or parameter regularization, while overlooking the potential of auxiliary modalities, such as text, to preserve semantic stability and enable incremental plasticity. We observe that the frozen text encoder in pretrained vision-language models can serve as a stable semantic anchor across domains. To decouple the roles of vision and text, we propose Prompt-Anchored vision-text Distillation (PAD), an asymmetric vision-text framework for semantic alignment and cross-domain generalization. On the textual side, we distill prompts to preserve vision-text alignment under a fixed semantic space, acting as a global semantic reference rather than a dominant learning signal. On the visual side, an EMA-based teacher with an adaptive prompt pool enables domain-wise adaptation by allocating new slots while freezing past ones. Extensive experiments show that PAD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods across seen and unseen domains, achieving a strong balance between stability and plasticity. Project page: https://github.com/zu-zi/PAD.
items.abstract_zh: 终身行人重识别（LReID）旨在用顺序收集的数据训练一个可泛化的模型，但新域不断出现会导致语义漂移、适应力受限和灾难性遗忘。现有无样本方法多依赖纯视觉蒸馏或参数正则化，忽视了文本等辅助模态在保持语义稳定与实现增量可塑性上的潜力。本文观察到，预训练视觉-语言模型中冻结的文本编码器可作为跨域稳定的语义锚点。为解耦视觉与文本的角色，作者提出提示锚定视觉-文本蒸馏（PAD）这一非对称框架：文本侧蒸馏提示，在固定语义空间下保持视觉-文本对齐，充当全局语义参考而非主导学习信号；视觉侧采用基于EMA的教师模型与自适应提示池，通过分配新槽位、冻结旧槽位实现按域适应。实验表明，PAD在已见与未见域上均显著优于现有最先进方法，在稳定性与可塑性之间取得良好平衡。
items.highlight_zh: 冻结文本编码器作语义锚，解耦视觉与文本以兼顾稳定与可塑
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：终身行人重识别要求模型按顺序在不同场景（不同摄像头、数据集）上持续学习，既要记住旧域（稳定性），又要适应新域（可塑性）。但现实中常顾此失彼：新数据一来，旧知识被覆盖（灾难性遗忘），语义表示也会漂移；同时出于隐私考虑，旧数据不能保存（无样本设定）。
2) 方法：作者借用预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）中冻结的文本编码器，把它当作“语义锚”——它固定不动、不随新域漂移，可为所有域提供统一参照系。在此基础上提出PAD，非对称地划分视觉与文本的职责：文本侧只做提示（prompt）蒸馏，维持图-文对齐，起全局参照作用而非主导学习信号；视觉侧用基于EMA的教师模型加自适应提示池，遇到新域就开一个新“槽位”，旧槽位冻结，从而既记住旧域又能学新域。
3) 结果：在已见域和未见域的大量实验中，PAD都明显超过现有最先进方法，在“不遗忘”与“能学新”之间取得更好平衡。
4) 为何重要：它为终身学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡提供了新思路——不必存储旧样本，而是借助冻结的多模态语义空间来稳住表示；对监控安防等需要模型持续更新的行人检索场景有实际价值。

rm.usage: 终身行人重识别的提示锚定蒸馏可迁移到雷达多相机跨视角的敌方机器人身份保持与持续跟踪，防止ID漂移与灾难性遗忘。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:APPO: Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization for Vi
items.title_en: APPO: Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization for Video Reasoning
items.title_zh: APPO：面向视频推理的注意力引导感知策略优化
items.abstract_en: Complex video reasoning, actually, relies excessively on fine-grained perception rather than on expert (e.g., Ph.D, Science)-level reasoning.Through extensive empirical observation, we have recognized the critical impact of perception.In particular, when perception ability is almost fixed, enhancing reasoning from Qwen3-8B to OpenAI-o3 yields only 0.7% performance improvement. Conversely, even minimal change in perception model scale (from 7B to 32B) boosts performance by 1.4%, indicating enhancing perception, rather than reasoning, is more critical to improve performance.Therefore, exploring how to enhance perception ability through reasoning without the need for expensive fine-grained annotation information is worthwhile.To achieve this goal, we specially propose APPO, the Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization algorithm that leverages token-level dense rewards to improve model's fine-grained perception.The core idea behind APPO is to optimize those tokens from different responses that primarily focus on the same crucial video frame (called intra-group perception tokens).Experimental results on diverse video benchmarks and models with different scales (3/7B) demonstrate APPO consistently outperforms GRPO and DAPO (0.5% 4%). We hope our work provides a promising approach to effectively enhance model's perception abilities through reasoning in a low-cost manner, serving diverse scenarios and demands.
items.abstract_zh: 复杂视频推理其实过度依赖细粒度感知，而非专家级（如博士、科研水平）推理。通过大量实证观察，作者发现感知能力影响关键：当感知能力基本固定时，把推理端从Qwen3-8B换成OpenAI-o3，性能仅提升0.7%；而感知模型规模从7B增到32B，性能就提升1.4%，说明增强感知比增强推理更能提升效果。因此，如何在不依赖昂贵细粒度标注的前提下通过推理提升感知能力值得探索。为此作者提出APPO——注意力引导的感知策略优化算法，利用token级密集奖励提升模型细粒度感知。其核心思想是优化那些来自不同回答、却主要关注同一关键视频帧的token（称为组内感知token）。在多种视频基准与不同规模模型（3B/7B）上，APPO持续优于GRPO和DAPO（0.5%~4%）。作者希望该工作为低成本通过推理增强模型感知能力提供可行路径。
items.highlight_zh: 用token级密集奖励强化视频细粒度感知，稳定超越GRPO/DAPO
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：视频推理任务中，人们通常认为“推理能力”是决定表现的关键，但作者发现真正的瓶颈是“感知”——模型能否看清视频里的关键细节。
2) 关键证据：在感知能力相近时，把推理模型从Qwen3-8B换成OpenAI-o3，性能只涨0.7%；而只把感知模型从7B放大到32B，性能就涨1.4%。也就是说，投入提升感知比提升推理性价比更高。
3) 方法：作者提出APPO（注意力引导的感知策略优化）。难点在于细粒度感知通常需要昂贵的逐帧标注。APPO 的做法是在强化学习中（类似GRPO的组内比较）把奖励细化到token级：在一组不同回答里，找出那些实际上都“盯着”同一关键视频帧的token，称为组内感知token，重点优化它们，等于用推理过程反过来教模型“该看哪里”，从而在没有额外标注的情况下提升感知。
4) 结果：在多个视频基准、3B与7B两种规模的模型上，APPO都稳定超过GRPO和DAPO，提升幅度约0.5%~4%。
5) 意义：它提供了一条低成本提升多模态模型感知能力的路径——不靠额外标注，只靠强化学习奖励信号的设计；对视频问答、长视频理解等场景具有参考价值。

rm.usage: 注意力引导的感知策略优化用token级奖励增强细粒度感知，思路可借鉴到装甲板等细粒度检测的RL训练，但面向视频推理，需改造。

items.title_en: PhysHead: Simulation-Ready Gaussian Head Avatars
items.title_zh: PhysHead：仿真就绪的高斯头部化身
items.abstract_en: Realistic digital avatars require expressive and dynamic hair motion; however, most existing head avatar methods assume rigid hair movement. These methods often fail to disentangle hair from the head, representing it as a simple outer shell and failing to capture its natural volumetric behavior. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing PhysHead, a hybrid representation for animatable head avatars with realistic hair dynamics learned from multiview video. At the core is a 3D Gaussian-based layered representation of the head. Our approach combines a 3D parametric mesh for the head with strand-based hair, which can be directly simulated using physics engines. For the appearance model, we employ Gaussian primitives attached to both the head mesh and hair segments. This representation enables the creation of photorealistic head avatars with dynamic hair behavior, such as wind-blown motion, overcoming the constraints of rigid hair in existing methods. However, these animation capabilities also require new training schemes. In particular, we propose the use of VLM-based models to generate appearance of regions that are occluded in the dynamic training sequences. In quantitative and qualitative studies, we demonstrate the capabilities of the proposed model and compare it with existing baselines. We show that our method can synthesize physically plausible hair motion besides expression and camera control. For additional results and code, please refer to https://physhead.github.io

rm.usage: 高斯头部化身与头发物理动画，与RoboMaster各任务无关。

items.title_en: Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation
items.title_zh: 物理模拟器在环的视频生成
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion-based video generation have achieved remarkable visual realism but still struggle to obey basic physical laws such as gravity, inertia, and collision. Generated objects often move inconsistently across frames, exhibit implausible dynamics, or violate physical constraints, limiting the realism and reliability of AI-generated videos. We address this gap by introducing Physical Simulator In-the-loop Video Generation (PSIVG), a novel framework that integrates a physical simulator into the video diffusion process. Starting from a template video generated by a pre-trained diffusion model, PSIVG reconstructs the 4D scene and foreground object meshes, initializes them within a physical simulator, and generates physically consistent trajectories. These simulated trajectories are then used to guide the video generator toward spatio-temporally physically coherent motion. To further improve texture consistency during object movement, we propose a Test-Time Texture Consistency Optimization (TTCO) technique that adapts text and feature embeddings based on pixel correspondences from the simulator. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PSIVG produces videos that better adhere to real-world physics while preserving visual quality and diversity. Project Page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/PSIVG

rm.usage: 物理模拟器在环的视频生成可生成符合物理的运动视频，理论上用于仿真训练数据增广，但与sim-to-real感知/导航/策略迁移关联较间接。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation
items.title_en: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
items.title_zh: ConceptPose：使用概念向量的免训练零样本物体姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics, yet most methods require extensive, dataset-specific training. Concurrently, large-scale vision language models show remarkable zero-shot capabilities. In this work, we bridge these two worlds by introducing ConceptPose, a framework for object pose estimation that is both training-free and model-free. ConceptPose leverages a vision-language-model (VLM) to create open-vocabulary 3D concept maps, where each point is tagged with a concept vector derived from saliency maps. By establishing robust 3D-3D correspondences across concept maps, our approach allows precise estimation of 6DoF relative pose. Without any object or dataset-specific training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on common zero shot relative pose estimation benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by a relative 62% in average ADD(-S) score, including methods that utilize extensive dataset-specific training.

rm.usage: 免训练零样本位姿估计思路可参考用于新目标（新赛季能量单元或装甲板）的6D位姿估计，省去逐目标训练；但VLM推理慢、精度有限，实时自瞄仍需传统PnP+灯条几何，只能作辅助/备用方案。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:JoPPO: Hierarchical Photography Assessment via Contrastive J
items.title_en: JoPPO: Hierarchical Photography Assessment via Contrastive Joint Conditional Probabilistic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: JoPPO：通过对比联合条件概率强化学习的分层摄影评估
items.abstract_en: With the advancement of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), employing VLM-as-a-Judge for visual evaluation has become a widely adopted metric in vision research. However, existing VLM-as-a-Judge approaches suffer from biased scoring outcomes with low discrimination and lack the capacity for unified multi-attribute compositional assessment. To address these limitations, we propose a novel training paradigm, termed JoPPO (**Jo**int **P**robabilistic **P**olicy **O**ptimization) that enables the VLMs to learn ranking under compositional assessment constraints. We evaluate the JoPPO on image aesthetics as a testbed, a task requiring nuanced understanding of multiple attributes including composition, lighting, color and geometry. Training follows two stages: (1) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic composition dataset provided by automated data generation pipeline to instill compositional priors; and (2) Contrastive Joint Conditional Probabilistic Reinforcement Learning: building upon the GRPO algorithm, we introduce JoPPO, which compute reward based on the expected win rate of total scores derived from the conditional distribution of fine-grained attribute scores within batches, effectively enhancing the model's discriminative ability in composite evaluation. Across standard aesthetic benchmarks, our method achieves consistent improvements in ranking consistency, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization.

rm.usage: 面向图像美学评价的VLM-as-Judge排序学习，与自瞄、导航、策略等赛事环节几乎无交集，训练范式也不适用于机器人视觉任务。

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: 真实场景下的DROID-SLAM
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.

rm.usage: 动态场景下的实时RGB SLAM（不确定性感知BA）可用于哨兵在不完全静态环境（敌方机器人移动、遮挡）中的建图与定位，提升跟踪鲁棒性；但实车多依赖2D激光SLAM，需改造与融合才能落地。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Towards Robust Multi-Modal Semantic Segmentation with Teache
items.title_en: Towards Robust Multi-Modal Semantic Segmentation with Teacher-Student Framework and Hybrid Prototype Distillation
items.title_zh: 迈向鲁棒的多模态语义分割：教师-学生框架与混合原型蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Multimodal semantic segmentation (MMSS) faces significant challenges in real-world applications due to incomplete, degraded, or missing sensor data. To address this, we propose RobustSeg, an efficient teacher-student framework that enhances model robustness under missing-modality conditions while maintaining strong performance in full-modality scenarios. RobustSeg adopts a feedback-based self-distillation paradigm consisting of two complementary stages. Firstly, we introduce Hybrid Prototype Distillation (HPD), which enables more reliable knowledge transfer of both cross-modal and modality-specific aspects. Concretely, combined with dominant-modality selection, HPD performs cross-modal semantic distillation with high-level semantic prototypes to reduce modality bias. Meanwhile, HPD conducts intra-class feature variation distillation for modality-specific structural details. Secondly, to enable the teacher model to gradually produce more balanced and robust modality representations, we make the student model provide feedback from the non-dominant modality to the teacher, benefiting the entire distillation process. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art robustness (e.g., +2.40% missing-modality performance on DeLiVER) while causing almost no degradation in full-modality performance (only -0.1% mIoU). Moreover, evaluations using different backbones (AnySeg and CMNeXt) further validate the generalization ability of RobustSeg.

rm.usage: 面向传感器缺失/退化的多模态语义分割鲁棒性框架，思路可借鉴到雷达多相机或哨兵视觉+激光融合中的单路失效容错，但赛场目标类别固定、模态缺失场景有限，需较多改造。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ExtrinSplat: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Open-Voca
items.title_en: ExtrinSplat: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Understanding in 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.title_zh: ExtrinSplat：解耦几何与语义以实现3D高斯泼溅中的开放词汇理解
items.abstract_en: Lifting 2D open-vocabulary understanding into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes is a critical challenge. Mainstream methods, built on an embedding paradigm, suffer from three key flaws: (i) geometry-semantic inconsistency, where points, rather than objects, serve as the semantic basis, limiting semantic fidelity; (ii) semantic bloat from injecting gigabytes of feature data into the geometry; and (iii) semantic rigidity, as one feature per Gaussian struggles to capture rich polysemy. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ExtrinSplat, a framework built on the extrinsic paradigm that decouples geometry from semantics. Instead of embedding features, ExtrinSplat clusters Gaussians into multi-granularity, overlapping 3D object groups. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) then interprets these groups to generate lightweight textual hypotheses, creating an extrinsic index layer that natively supports complex polysemy. By replacing costly feature embedding with lightweight indices, ExtrinSplat reduces scene adaptation time from hours to minutes and lowers storage overhead by several orders of magnitude. On benchmark tasks for open-vocabulary 3D object selection and semantic segmentation, ExtrinSplat outperforms established embedding-based frameworks, validating the efficacy and efficiency of the proposed extrinsic paradigm.

rm.usage: 3D高斯泼溅的开放词汇理解，主要面向语义场景编辑与检索，与RM中已知刚性目标的检测、定位、瞄准需求关联很弱。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Vocabulary Scaling Law: Tuning Open-vocabulary Predictors fo
items.title_en: Vocabulary Scaling Law: Tuning Open-vocabulary Predictors for Their Openness
items.title_zh: 词汇缩放定律：为开放性调优开放词汇预测器
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary learning on CLIP provides remarkable generalization on diverse concepts, however, falters under the realistic streaming open-world evaluations for Stability against distractor classes and Extensibility to novel classes. Current fine-tuning methods often fail these tests since they are mainly designed for closed-set conditions, leading to the performance gaps while the target vocabulary progressively scales. We formalize a "vocabulary scaling law" showing that these openness measures can be lower-bounded by performance on the full class-name universe, implying that robust fine-tuning should: (i) account for the entire vocabulary, (ii) tune class-name embeddings rather than context, and (iii) enforce orthogonality between prompt embeddings including training and open-set class names. Guided by our analysis, we propose Submodular-Vocabulary Fine-tuning (SVFT), a bi-level optimization framework that approximates the intractable objective of tuning all class name embedding by greedily selecting a small, informative subset of class names via constrained submodular maximization, thus, allows the employment of efficient greedy algorithm for the near-optimal class-name subset selection to fine-tune CLIP instead of using all open classes. Across extensive experiments, SVFT consistently improves both stability and extensibility, advancing the openness and practical robustness of CLIP-based vision-language models.

rm.usage: 开放词汇CLIP微调的词汇缩放规律，属通用视觉语言模型理论，对装甲板/能量单元等封闭集合识别任务帮助很小。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Taming Preference Mode Collapse via Directional Decoupling A
items.title_en: Taming Preference Mode Collapse via Directional Decoupling Alignment in Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 通过方向性解耦对齐驯服扩散强化学习中的偏好模式崩溃
items.abstract_en: Recent studies have demonstrated significant progress in aligning text-to-image diffusion models with human preference via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. However, while existing methods achieve high scores on automated reward metrics, they often lead to Preference Mode Collapse (PMC)-a specific form of reward hacking where models converge on narrow, high-scoring outputs (e.g., images with monolithic styles or pervasive overexposure), severely degrading generative diversity. In this work, we introduce and quantify this phenomenon, proposing DivGenBench, a novel benchmark designed to measure the extent of PMC. We posit that this collapse is driven by over-optimization along the reward model's inherent biases. Building on this analysis, we propose Directional Decoupling Alignment (D^2-Align), a novel framework that mitigates PMC by directionally correcting the reward signal.Specifically, our method first learns a directional correction within the reward model's embedding space while keeping the model frozen.This correction is then applied to the reward signal during the optimization process, preventing the model from collapsing into specific modes and thereby maintaining diversity. Our comprehensive evaluation, combining qualitative analysis with quantitative metrics for both quality and diversity, reveals that D^2-Align achieves superior alignment with human preference.

rm.usage: 扩散模型RLHF中的偏好模式崩溃与多样性评测，属于生成式图像对齐研究，与RM任何环节均无直接关系。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:OpenVoxel: Training-Free Grouping and Captioning Voxels for
items.title_en: OpenVoxel: Training-Free Grouping and Captioning Voxels for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
items.title_zh: OpenVoxel：面向开放词汇3D场景理解的免训练体素分组与描述生成
items.abstract_en: We propose OpenVoxel, a training-free algorithm for grouping and captioning sparse voxels for the open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding tasks. Given the sparse voxel rasterization (SVR) model obtained from multi-view images of a 3D scene, our OpenVoxel is able to produce meaningful groups that describe different objects in the scene. Also, by leveraging powerful Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), our OpenVoxel successfully build an informative scene map by captioning each group, enabling further 3D scene understanding tasks such as open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) or referring expression segmentation (RES). Unlike previous methods, our method is training-free and does not introduce embeddings from a CLIP/BERT text encoder. Instead, we directly proceed with text-to-text search using MLLMs. Through extensive experiments, our method demonstrates superior performance compared to recent studies, particularly in complex referring expression segmentation (RES) tasks.

rm.usage: 免训练体素分组与描述生成可作哨兵/雷达全局场景语义建图的思路参考，但RM场地目标已知且需实时高频，该方法偏离线描述，实用度低。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:SPAN: Spatial-Projection Alignment for Monocular 3D Object D
items.title_en: SPAN: Spatial-Projection Alignment for Monocular 3D Object Detection
items.title_zh: SPAN：用于单目3D目标检测的空间-投影对齐
items.abstract_en: Existing monocular 3D detectors typically tame the pronounced nonlinear regression of 3D bounding box through decoupled prediction paradigm, which employs multiple branches to estimate geometric center, depth, dimensions, and rotation angle separately.Although this decoupling strategy simplifies the learning process, it inherently ignores the geometric collaborative constraints between different attributes, resulting in the lack of geometric consistency prior, thereby leading to suboptimal performance. To address this issue, we propose novel Spatial-Projection Alignment (SPAN) with two pivotal components: (i). Spatial Point Alignment enforces an explicit global spatial constraint between the predicted and ground-truth 3D bounding boxes, thereby rectifying spatial drift caused by decoupled attribute regression. (ii). 3D-2D Projection Alignment ensures that the projected 3D box is aligned tightly within its corresponding 2D detection bounding box on the image plane, mitigating projection misalignment overlooked in previous works. To ensure training stability, we further introduce a Hierarchical Task Learning strategy that progressively incorporates spatial-projection alignment as 3D attribute predictions refine, preventing early stage error propagation across attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can be easily integrated into any established monocular 3D detector and delivers significant performance improvements.

rm.usage: 单目3D检测的空间-投影对齐思路可用于自瞄中从单张图像直接回归装甲板3D框（中心、深度、尺寸、朝向），为PnP位姿估计提供几何一致性先验或作为兜底方案，提升远距/小目标时的位姿稳定性。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LL
items.title_en: Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LLM-based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Embodied Exploration
items.title_zh: 利用长期记忆进行探索：面向具身探索的基准与基于多模态LLM的强化学习框架
items.abstract_en: An ideal embodied agent should possess lifelong learning capabilities to handle long-horizon and complex tasks, enabling continuous operation in general environments. This not only requires the agent to accurately accomplish given tasks but also to leverage long-term episodic memory to optimize decision-making. However, existing mainstream one-shot embodied tasks primarily focus on task completion results, neglecting the crucial process of exploration and memory utilization. To address this, we propose Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE), which aims to unify the agent's exploratory cognition and decision-making behaviors to promote lifelong learning. We further construct a corresponding dataset and benchmark, LMEE-Bench, incorporating multi-goal navigation and memory-based question answering to comprehensively evaluate both the process and outcome of embodied exploration. To enhance the agent's memory recall and proactive exploration capabilities, we propose MemoryExplorer, a novel method that fine-tunes a multimodal large language model through reinforcement learning to encourage active memory querying. By incorporating a multi-task reward function that includes action prediction, frontier selection, and question answering, our model achieves proactive exploration. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art embodied exploration models demonstrate that our approach achieves significant advantages in long-horizon embodied tasks. Our dataset and code will be released at https://wangsen99.github.io/papers/lmee/

rm.usage: 其长期情景记忆与多模态LLM+RL的具身探索框架，可为哨兵长时间自主巡逻中利用历史记忆优化占点/探索决策提供思路参考，但需针对比赛地图重训与改造。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cl
items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.

rm.usage: 无对应局部点云配准可作为哨兵建图定位中的里程计/回环配准工具，或用于工程机器人用深度点云对能量单元做快速位姿配准与抓取对齐。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ReAttnCLIP: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Ima
items.title_en: ReAttnCLIP: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Image Segmentation via Re-defined Attention in CLIP
items.title_zh: ReAttnCLIP：通过重新定义 CLIP 中的注意力实现免训练开放词汇遥感图像分割
items.abstract_en: Remote sensing image segmentation is critical for a range of applications, including natural disaster monitoring and precision agriculture. Open-vocabulary segmentation enhances flexibility by removing fixed category constraints, enabling more fine-grained and adaptive scene understanding. Unlike CLIP's original pretraining objective, which emphasizes global image-text alignment, segmentation tasks require accurate and discriminative patch-level representations to support precise pixel-wise predictions. As a result, the quality of attention maps--particularly those generated in the final transformer layers--plays a pivotal role in guiding inter-region interactions. However, current methods generate suboptimal representations when capturing the complex spatial hierarchies in remote sensing. We address this gap by optimizing CLIP's 197x197 attention matrix through three key modifications: (1) substituting the 196x196 patch-to-patch submatrix with intermediate-layer feature similarities to preserve spatial structures; (2) prioritizing intermediate-layer attention for global-to-local (class-to-patch) token alignment to reduce classification interference; (3) disabling the \texttt [CLS] token's self-attention to mitigate bias. Extensive experiments on eight remote sensing benchmarks and two building/road extraction datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing training-free approaches.

rm.usage: 面向遥感图像的开词汇分割方法，与赛场装甲板/机器人识别场景差异较大，且比赛目标类别固定、无需开放词汇，关联很弱。
